observed_anchors: Current main has merged ClayPackageResolution/v1 exact provider resolution while symbol semantics remain NOT_SELECTED.
Current authorized corpus evidence discussed on PR #674 shows a plain use path can be symbol-shaped: use frank.entity.Frank while frank.entity is the module and Frank is a top-level entity.

PR #682 proposes an import-time fail-closed wildcard collision surface; Rust and Go demonstrate materially different viable import/name-resolution mechanisms and therefore cannot be inherited as Clay authority.
generated_reality: Reject any wildcard-import name collision immediately at import-resolution time.
counter_reality: Keep conflicting wildcard candidates latent and reject only when a name is actually used ambiguously; an explicit local declaration may shadow an otherwise unused wildcard candidate.
experiment_method: Disposable in-memory semantic comparator over three bounded collision cases. No product repository mutation, external effect, training, or authority change.
measured_result: The import-time collision candidate is strictly more conservative on this synthetic discriminator: it rejects two cases admitted by the use-site-aware model, while both reject an actually used ambiguous collision.
interpretation: This falsifies equivalence between import-time rejection and use-site-aware rejection. It does not select Clay semantics. Immediate wildcard collision rejection carries a demonstrated liveness/expressiveness cost and should remain a candidate until corpus/use-site evidence discriminates it.
strongest_counterevidence: Fail-closed import-time rejection is simpler and may be intentionally selected by Clay for determinism/safety; the synthetic comparator does not measure real Clay corpus compatibility or compiler complexity.
next_discriminator: Resolve the plain-use name-binding contract first (module versus exported symbol versus other explicitly admitted form) using authorized corpus evidence and exact-head tests. Only then compare wildcard collision timing on actual referenced/unreferenced names before feeding symbol ownership into the nominal checker -> ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 -> single ClayVM path.
